results.name: Nepal Flood 2026 Response - Lower Trishuli and Bhote Koshi Corridor [BUILDING]
results.shortDescription: On August 26, 2026, a flash flood struck the Trisuli and Bhotekoshi valleys in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts, Bagmati Province, Nepal. Timure, Syabrubesi, and Trishuli Bazar were among the hardest-hit areas. Nepal Police reported at least 669 confirmed deaths as of the evening of August 29, with 800+ still missing. Houses, roads, bridges, and hydropower infrastructure sustained damage across the affected districts. These figures are still being verified and are likely to change as search and rescue continues.
results.author: adiatmad
